session_title: 29 Oct 2026 NSE Intraday S&R Diagnostic & Variance Audit
review_author: AntiGravity Autonomous Quant Engine & Multidisciplinary Audit

hits_respected_levels.name: Varun Beverages
hits_respected_levels.insight: Textbook FMCG demand absorption. The S2 Zone at ₹404.70 caught the exact low of the day on NSE. The subsequent bounce into the ₹416.60 supply pocket allowed a clean +2.17% gain.

hits_respected_levels.name: Tata Power
hits_respected_levels.insight: High-volume institutional absorption at ₹334.00 confirmed the ascending channel lower boundary. The stock rallied aggressively into our R1 target zone, generating our highest absolute intraday profit.

hits_respected_levels.name: Polycab India
hits_respected_levels.insight: Demand shelf was respected with high precision: price tested ₹7,721 and exploded to ₹7,948 (+₹227/share intraday surge). However, lack of a trailing profit lock allowed the position to retrace to a scratch during the 14:30 market-wide pullback.

missed_runners.name: Central Depository Services
missed_runners.root_cause: Pre-market institutional order flow created an opening gap-up at ₹1,232. The stock was too strong to retrace to our static S1 zone (₹1,210).
missed_runners.flaw_identified: Over-reliance on deep pullback limit orders. The algorithm lacked an 'Opening Range Breakout / Above-VWAP Confirmation' trigger for high-momentum days.

missed_runners.name: HDFC Bank
missed_runners.root_cause: Strong Nifty Bank index momentum pushed HDFC Bank upwards from the opening bell. Static monthly S1 (₹652) lagged behind the fast-shifting market regime.
missed_runners.flaw_identified: Static S&R zones derived from weekly charts failed to adapt dynamically to daily institutional VWAP trends.

variance_and_flaw_analysis.diagnostic: Silver ETF consolidated tightly between ₹18.28 and ₹18.54. Indian morning sessions have low commodity volatility because global London and COMEX markets open after 13:30 IST. EOD auto square-off forced an exit at the bottom of the box.
variance_and_flaw_analysis.correction: Restrict intraday commodity ETF trades to post-13:30 IST window when London/US COMEX volumes ignite. In morning sessions, allocate 100% of capital to high-beta cash equities.

variance_and_flaw_analysis.impact: Surged +2.92% (+₹450 peak profit) but ended flat at -₹44.00
variance_and_flaw_analysis.diagnostic: The S1 bounce reached ₹7,948, but the engine held with a rigid 15:15 EOD square-off rule and no trailing stop. When institutional profit-taking hit at 14:45, a winning trade eroded into a scratch.
variance_and_flaw_analysis.correction: Deploy 'Lock-in-Greens' Protocol: Once unrealized gain hits +1.8%, automatically move stop-loss to Breakeven (+0.4% above entry) to guarantee profit retention.

variance_and_flaw_analysis.diagnostic: Treating S&R purely as static horizontal price bands caused the engine to sit idle while two top universe names delivered +4% intraday trends.
variance_and_flaw_analysis.correction: Implement Dual-Trigger Execution: Trigger A enters on Demand Dips (S1/S2); Trigger B enters on a 15-min Opening Range Breakout holding above VWAP.
